doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Birth in 1904 in the Tremé
summary: He gives his birthdate and says he was born in the Creole Tremé section.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: What year were you born in today?
18th, February. And where were you born?
New Orleans. What section? In the Tremé. In the Tremé section.

In the Tremé section. What, right off? That's St. Anne Street. Green, Cleveland, and Derby. Oh, yeah. Blocked from the old Tremé. It used to be Tremé, Mark. It was in the Darlene. In the Darlene Street.
